statement: Secondary-market H100 80GB hardware prices as listed on Compute Exchange: $25,000-$40,000 new, $21,000-$34,000 refurbished, $15,000-$28,000 used; HGX H100 8-GPU systems above $350,000.
why: Street/resale pricing for the prior-generation flagship accelerator is a display overlay on merchant-GPU hardware value; no baseline or change is stated on the page, so it is a static level only.

impact.mechanism: Secondary-market resale levels for H100 hardware indicate what installed prior-generation NVIDIA silicon fetches, but with no stated baseline the level alone does not signal direction of demand or supply.

evidence.excerpt: Full HGX H100 8-GPU systems routinely exceed $350,000.

confidence.basis: Single secondary vendor pricing guide; cross-check figures mentioned in the article were explicitly not independently fetched or verified.

dispersion: New $25,000-$40,000; refurbished $21,000-$34,000 (80-85% of new); used $15,000-$28,000 (60-70% of new). Unverified leads in the same document cite far lower H100 SXM5 resale figures ($6,000-$15,000), so the true street range may be wider.
